summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 2-year time charter extension for its feeder containership M/V Jonathan P at a gross daily rate of $26,000. The 2006-built, 1,740 TEU vessel's new charter runs 24-26 months starting late November 2026, after dry-dock, in direct continuation of its current charter. The deal is expected to generate approximately $12.7 million of EBITDA over the minimum period and raises charter coverage to roughly 97% (2026), 86% (2027), and 50% (2028). This is an operational contract, not a special situation.
